projects.name: spire
projects.description: Track accounts, income and long-term projections on your own infrastructure. Handles savings, investments, loans and crypto — live prices, price history and real-time portfolio value — plus configurable pay cycles, split allocations and growth projections. Ships as a multi-arch Docker image, so your data never leaves your server.

projects.name: cs-movement
projects.description: Counter-Strike movement as a library: bhop, surf, air-strafing, ladders, ducking and stamina, with plane-based brush collision. Faithful to CS:GO's accelerate and friction cvars, the air-speed cap and the takeoff clamp. Renderer-agnostic with zero runtime dependencies — you bring the geometry and the draw loop. The core has no DOM dependency, so it runs headless under Node for replay validation and deterministic lockstep.

projects.name: dotship
projects.description: Browse any public GitHub repository, pick the config files you need, and save them exactly where they belong on your machine. Repo authors can drop in a .dotship.yml manifest to map every file to its destination, so a whole dotfiles setup installs in one go.
